name: Affinity
summary: Affinity is a multiplayer horror game where you can jump in and experience the fear alongside other players. Explore dark, eerie environments filled with tension, mystery, and unexpected scares that keep you on edge. Whether you're sticking with a group for safety or wandering off on your own, every moment feels unpredictable and intense.
